constellations.summary: Dendro dual-sword technician generating Chisel-Light Mirrors for lethal coordinated projection rain attacks.
Projection attacks decrease Elemental Skill CD by 1.2s (smoother rotations).
Each Chisel-Light Mirror generated grants +50 EM (stacking up to +200 EM).
Maintains permanent 3-Mirror state for 6s after Burst with +10% CRIT Rate and +70% CRIT DMG.

teamComps.name: Quickbloom Extermination
teamComps.rotation: Nahida E Q -> Yelan E Q -> Kuki E -> Alhaitham Q (wait 2s) -> 3-Mirror Normal Attacks

notes: Cast Burst at 0 mirrors, wait 2 seconds for 3 mirrors to spawn, then execute Normal Attacks -> E -> Charged Attack to sustain 3 mirrors for 12 straight seconds!
